text: One morning Dupin. <break time="0.8s" /> Wearing a pair of green glasses. <break time="0.8s" /> Called on the Minister at his house. <break time="0.8s" /> And found him yawning lazily. <break time="0.8s" /> Pretending to be bored. <break time="0.8s" /> Complaining of weak eyes. <break time="0.8s" /> Dupin used the glasses. <break time="0.8s" /> To hide his eyes. <break time="0.8s" /> While he carefully looked around the room. <break time="0.8s" /> As they talked. <break time="0.8s" /> Hanging from the fireplace. <break time="0.8s" /> By a dirty blue ribbon. <break time="0.8s" /> Was a card rack. <break time="0.8s" /> In which lay a letter. <break time="0.8s" /> Soiled and torn nearly in two. <break time="0.8s" /> It had a large black seal. <break time="0.8s" /> And was addressed to the Minister himself. <break time="0.8s" /> So it looked nothing like the letter the Prefect had described. <break time="0.8s" /> Yet such a dirty letter. <break time="0.8s" /> Did not suit the tidy Minister. <break time="0.8s" /> And its worn edges showed. <break time="0.8s" /> It had been turned inside out. <break time="0.8s" /> Like a glove. <break time="0.8s" /> Returning the next morning. <break time="0.8s" /> For the snuff box he had purposely left. <break time="0.8s" /> Dupin was talking with the Minister. <break time="0.8s" /> When a loud shot rang out. <break time="0.8s" /> Below the window. <break time="0.8s" /> As screams followed. <break time="0.8s" /> The Minister rushed to look outside. <break time="0.8s" /> And Dupin quickly took the letter. <break time="0.8s" /> Putting in its place. <break time="0.8s" /> A copy he had made at home. <break time="0.8s" /> The gun. <break time="0.8s" /> Which held no bullet. <break time="0.8s" /> Was fired by a man. <break time="0.8s" /> Whom Dupin had paid. <break time="0.8s" /> And he was soon let go. <break time="0.8s" /> As a madman. <break time="0.8s" /> Inside the copy. <break time="0.8s" /> Dupin had written a line. <break time="0.8s" /> From a French play. <break time="0.8s" /> So that the Minister would one day know. <break time="0.8s" /> Who had beaten him.
